summary.text: Cesar Blanco is a Democratic member of the Texas Senate representing District 29, covering El Paso and several West Texas counties; he was first elected in 2020 after six years in the Texas House. He serves on the Business and Commerce, Health and Human Services, Natural Resources and Economic Development, and Water, Agriculture, and Rural Affairs committees.

paragraphs.text: Blanco was raised in El Paso, served in the U.S. Navy, and graduated from the University of Texas at El Paso, after which he worked for three Members of Congress representing El Paso and West Texas.
He served in the Texas House from 2015 to 2021 and was named a Best Legislator by Texas Monthly in his freshman session.
He is a member of the Sunset Advisory Commission and vice chair of the Texas Senate Hispanic Caucus.
He lives in El Paso with his wife, Lili, and their daughter.
